text.tspan: Normal boot, PA19 does not output boot information.
PA18/19 switch from DBUART to SWD.
The SWD function of PA43/44 is disabled.
Normal boot, PA19 outputs boot information.
PA18/19 work as DBUART, PA43/44 work as SWD.
PA18/19 work as DBUART, PA43/44 work as SWD.
PA19 does not output boot information.
PA18/19 switch from DBUART to SWD.
The SWD function of PA43/44 is disabled.
C2,C3,C4,C6 are the external capacitors for the internal power supply.
SBxx: Support external NOR/NAND FLASH only if internal MPI3 SIP pads are unused. NC otherwise.
PA12~17 can only be connected to one type of storage medium at a time.
VCC and PVDD are power input pins of the PMU.
Sum of ext. capacitors for VSYS_3V3, VDD33_VOUT1 & VDD33_VOUT2 < 9.6 μF
U2 supports standard eMMC 153‑ball package. Resistor R9 must be soldered when eMMC is populated.
VDDIOA pin is the power supply pin for chip GPIOs.
VSYS_3V3 is only for internal use of the MCU.
Trace parasitic capacitance <10 pF; implement 3‑D ground shielding.
32.768KHz crystal omitted, internal RC oscillator used instead.
U3 supports P2P soldering of SPI NOR/NAND and SD NAND chips.
Boot from external memory only when there is no embedded flash inside the chip.
The VBAT pin integrates an internal GPADC for voltage measurement.
When the internal charger is not used, change C11 to 100 nF.
VDD33_VOUT1: 150 mA max, for external Flash & sensors.
VDD33_VOUT2: 150 mA max, for vibrator power supply.
Chip VSYS pin powers VDDIOA, AVDD_BRF, AVDD33_AUD and external Flash. Use star topology for PCB traces.
VDDIOSB: Power input for internal SIP MPI2 & MPI3 pads,tied to VDD33_VOUT1.
VDDIOSA: Power input for internal SIP MPI1 pads, tied to VDD18_VOUT.
C19,C20 are the external capacitors for the internal power supply.
If the internal charging module of the chip is used, add an OVP protection chip before the VBUS input pin.

Minimize the trace impedance between the POGO PIN and the chip’s VBUS pin during PCB routing. This impedance will cause voltage drop. When selecting the charging current, ensure the voltage at the chip’s VBUS pin is greater than 4.6 V.
The VBUS pin can be left floating when the internal charger is not used.
C17 is the external capacitor for internal SIP PSRAM power supply.
Configure the CFG boot settings according to the type of external storage medium.
All GPIO can assign to I2C,SPI,UART,CAN,PDM,PTA/BT,xTIM,PWM,I2S,PTM,LCDC and DCMI
